messages:
incident-bot: Pager: GPU queue growth detected in eu1-primary cluster. queue_length > 95th percentile, autoscale failing. Alert: HIGH_SEVERITY. Impacts: increased latency, 429 throttles. Paging primary on-call (lydia).

lydia (oncall): I'm on it. Will pull logs and check autoscaler events. tagging @emma @raj for runtime/autoscale context.

emma (runtime-engineer): Seeing consistent OOM/scale errors from the autoscaler controller: cloud API returning 403 QuotaExceeded and 409 Conflict for instance requests. Also a few model transfer timeouts.

raj (sre): Can you paste the autoscaler error?

emma (runtime-engineer): logs snippet: ```2026-03-15T20:11:02Z autoscaler controller: failed to create node pool: APIError: quotaExceeded: instances.cpus quota reached for project redwood-inference-eu (code=403)
2026-03-15T20:11:14Z autoscaler controller: reconcile failed: cannot provision new gpu instances (region eu1): QuotaExceeded
```

lydia (oncall): So autoscaler can't add more machines due to cloud quota. Queue is growing; we're hitting token throttles for some routes. What's traffic distribution?

tom (prodops): Traffic to eu1 has spiked ~4x for last 8 minutes due to a customer load test. Several high-throughput customers are pinned to eu1 via routing policy. Fallback routing is enabled but weights are 0.

maya (support): Customer impact: two paying customers reported elevated latency and 425/429 responses: AcmeCorp (P0) and BetaGames (P1). CS already opened tickets; AcmeCorp on the line with support.

carlos (cs): AcmeCorp says some batch jobs failing; they asked for ETA. I'll escalate SLA if we need a mitigation plan.

lydia (oncall): Quick mitigations we can attempt: 1) enable cross-region fallback to eu-west-2 at 20% weight, 2) apply emergency per-customer rate-limits to non-critical tenants, 3) evict background/pre-warmed model loads to free GPUs. Which can we do fast?

raj (sre): I can flip the routing weight. tom can run evictions. emma, can you confirm model cache eviction won't break pinned sessions?

emma (runtime-engineer): Evicting prewarm pods OK for low-priority models, but pinned sessions for AcmeCorp must be preserved. I'll mark their sessions as sticky. We'll also disable model prefetch for 10m.

tom (prodops): Running route change now: ```redwood route update --from eu1 --to eu-west-2 --add-weight 20 --dry-run=false``` -> executing.

deploy-bot: Route change executed by tom at 20:18Z. New weights: eu1 80%, eu-west-2 20%. (reaction :white_check_mark:)

lydia (oncall): Monitor queue length and 99th latency. Raj, set an ephemeral circuit-breaker for routes exceeding 2s tail latency to reduce retries.

raj (sre): Setting route circuit-breaker: ```redwood route-config set eu1 --circuit-breaker 2s --backoff 30s``` -> applied.

emma (runtime-engineer): Starting targeted eviction of prewarm pods: ```kubectl label nodepool eu1-prewarm evict=true && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -l evict=true``` Will exclude AcmeCorp and BetaGames namespaces.

tom (prodops): Eviction completed. Freed 6 GPU slots. Autoscaler still failing to add nodes but freed capacity reduced queue by ~35% within 3 minutes.

maya (support): AcmeCorp confirms partial recovery for some jobs, but still seeing retries for large-batch workloads. BetaGames reports acceptable latency after reroute.

lydia (oncall): Good. Next: ask cloud team for immediate quota bump request and open a ticket with priority. Also consider temporary burst capacity using fallback pool (us-west-1) if eu-west-2 saturates.

raj (sre): I've opened a cloud support ticket (CS-5421) and requested quota increase for GPU instances in eu region. Also enabling emergency routing to us-west-1 if eu-west-2 > 75% util for 5m.

emma (runtime-engineer): Watch: KV cache miss rate increased due to cross-region reroute — might add some cold-start latency. We'll warm top models in eu-west-2 with small preloads for AcmeCorp. Running warm command: ```redwood model preload --region eu-west-2 --model pilot-13b --tenants AcmeCorp --timeout 120s```

tom (prodops): Warm completed for prioritized models. Monitoring metrics: eu1 queue length down 60%, eu-west-2 GPU util up to 42%, tail latency for AcmeCorp approx 850ms.

lydia (oncall): I'm going to hand the overnight to @raj. Raj: please continue monitoring cloud ticket and routing, keep support looped for customer updates. I'll brief on-call notes in #eng-oncall after handover.

raj (sre): Taking over. Action items assigned: 1) keep fallbacks at 20% and watch eu-west-2, 2) escalate cloud quota ticket if no response in 30m, 3) coordinate with CS for AcmeCorp postmortem.

carlos (cs): I’ll schedule a follow-up call with AcmeCorp for tomorrow 09:00 their timezone. Need summary and RCA when available.

maya (support): Logging incident impact in support tracker ticket SUP-9812. Will update customers with current mitigations and ETA for permanent fix.

lydia (oncall): Post-incident notes I'll capture: root cause = autoscaler blocked by cloud GPU quota; contributing factor = pinned routing + sudden customer load test; mitigations = cross-region reroute, prewarm eviction, circuit-breaker, cache warm in fallback region.

lydia (oncall): Last check before handoff: queue length stable, no new P0 alerts. Handing to @raj. If anything spikes >90% queue for eu1, escalate to pager.

raj (sre): Acknowledged. I'll keep channel open and update every 30m or on major state changes.
